rowgen.name: SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.LFunction_zero_re_nonpos
rowgen.check: @SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.LFunction_zero_re_nonpos : ∀ {N : ℕ} [inst : NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N}, χ.IsPrimitive → χ ≠ 1 → ∀ {s : ℂ}, DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s = 0 → s.re ≤ 0 → SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.IsTrivialPoint χ s
rowgen.doc: **The seam for `L(s, χ)`:** a zero of `LFunction χ` with `re s ≤ 0` is a trivial point

rowgen.name: SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.GRH_chi_iff_trivial
rowgen.check: @SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.GRH_chi_iff_trivial : ∀ {N : ℕ} [inst : NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N}, χ.IsPrimitive → χ ≠ 1 → (SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.GRH_chi χ ↔ SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.GRH_chi_trivial χ)
rowgen.doc: **The strip form and the form off the trivial points coincide**, for a primitive `χ ≠ 1`: the seam and the nonvanishing of `LFunction χ` on `re ≥ 1`.

rowgen.name: SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.LFunction_inv_conj
rowgen.check: @SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.LFunction_inv_conj : ∀ {N : ℕ} [inst : NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N}, χ ≠ 1 → ∀ (s : ℂ), DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ⁻¹ ((starRingEnd ℂ) s) = (starRingEnd ℂ) (DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s)
rowgen.doc: **The pairing:** `LFunction χ⁻¹ (conj s) = conj (LFunction χ s)` for every `s`, `χ ≠ 1` -- the series agreement on `re > 1` carried to `ℂ` by the identity theorem (both sides entire, `differentiable_LFunction`).

rowgen.name: SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.analyticOrderAt_LFunction_inv_conj
rowgen.check: @SIDEExplicitFormula.GRHWeil.analyticOrderAt_LFunction_inv_conj : ∀ {N : ℕ} [inst : NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N}, χ ≠ 1 → ∀ (w : ℂ), analyticOrderAt (DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ⁻¹) ((starRingEnd ℂ) w) = analyticOrderAt (DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ) w
rowgen.doc: **The multiplicities agree across the pair:** the vanishing order of `LFunction χ⁻¹` at `conj w` is that of `LFunction χ` at `w`, by Zeta23's `analyticOrderAt_conj_conj`.
